steps.content: The courtyard entrance isn't guarded, but the entire building is shrouded in some kind of indistinguishable halo.
It's probably the moon. You think to yourself as you climb over the wall into the courtyard. In the moonlight, you fall into a flowering shrub.
It's hard to imagine so many flowers can fit in such a small courtyard.
But more importantly, Sumire is kneeling near the flowers with a large amount of blood on her abdomen, which has soaked her clothes.
In the corridor stand two aloof, similarly dressed women. Behind them is some flickering candlelight, which outlines a seated figure on the paper screen.
The pressure is so incredibly intense, you feel as if it's almost breaking through the door. The next instant, you can clearly feel that the figure behind that door has already noticed you.
You can vaguely hear the conversation over a dozen meters away.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I... willingly accept the punishment.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I just wish that you can...

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: The Mentor has given you a chance, but you're still so stubborn.
A piercing sound of rupture sweeps past. Sounds like some weapon has struck Sumire.
Sumire trembles slightly. You hear the sound of blood dripping onto the stone.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: He... has everyone in his mind, even the Sinners, even us in the Garden... He would take the risk to save anyone he could.
steps.female_content: She... has everyone in her mind, even the Sinners, even us in the Garden... She would take the risk to save anyone she could.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: He's not like those people.
The woman in the corridor sneers.

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: The Mentor and everyone in the Garden are your only companions.

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: Yet you attacked them because of an outsider...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I'm really sorry.

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: You're really sorry? Can you make up for your mistakes by saying sorry?!
Got it.
The woman behind the screen, or rather, the Mentor, finally speaks.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: You should know, Sumire.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Every one of you is my mentee, my cherished masterpiece.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: I won't punish you too harshly no matter what mistakes you make.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Except for betrayal...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: My mentor, it's my fault... I have upset you.
Sumire grits her teeth. Her wound is still bleeding.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Good girl...

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: I will give you one more chance.
The Mentor's voice sounds extraordinarily gentle. Sumire jerks her head up as if she has found a glimpse of hope.
The shadow on the paper screen points to you. All eyes are on you, leaving you nowhere to hide.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Kill him.
Sumire spots you. Her shock, anxiety and fear all coalesce into deep despair.
But eventually, it turns into a few gentle words.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: You... came after all.

options: I couldn't leave you like this.

choices.text: I couldn't leave you like this.

steps.content: Sumire turns around to face the Mentor again.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I'll bear the responsibility for this.

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: You'll bear the responsibility? Humph. Sumire, you're as stupid as this person.

steps.speaker: Woman in Kimono
steps.content: Even though you stopped me from capturing him alive, he still came to have himself killed.
steps.female_content: Even though you stopped me from capturing her alive, she still came to have herself killed.

steps.content: Sumire doesn't respond but simply stares at the figure behind the paper screen.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Please let go of... cough cough...
Sumire's body is shaky and almost falling. The Mentor behind the paper screen sighs.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: I've seen so many betrayals, but never one like yours.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Perhaps you're just bewitched.
Her words are still so gentle, yet a second later, you are overwhelmed by an intense suffocating sense of danger.
The next thing you know, Sumire is standing before you.
You hear or see nothing, yet a split second later, Sumire tumbles down to the ground. A large amount of blood gushes out of the split wound in her abdomen.
Sumire looks back at you, then slowly collapses onto the ground.
You rush forward to hold her up.
Sumire!
Her face is pale. She bites her lip and says nothing.
Hang in there. I'll get you out of here.
Sumire shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Please just leave me... alone. This is the Garden's internal affair and has nothing to do with you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I just want you to get out of here.
Sumire breaks away from your hand and stands up to face the Mentor again.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: It's all my fault...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I've never pleaded for anything with you... but please, let him go...
steps.female_content: I've never pleaded for anything with you... but please, let her go...

steps.content: The person behind the paper screen remains silent for a long time.
You can't just carry Sumire and run away—At this moment, exposing your back to that terrifying Mentor simply means death.
You still have one last trump card. But at such a distance with two people in the corridor, using the shackles will probably only allow you to die with a little more dignity.
As you are figuring out a way to break through, the Mentor finally speaks up.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: ...Whatever. I didn't care whether this person is dead or not.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: But Sumire, you stay here.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Thank you...
Without the slightest hesitation, Sumire smiles in relief and extends her hand to the Mentor.
Sumire's hand appear exceptionally pale in the moonlight, perhaps due to the excessive blood loss.
Sumire has blocked assassination after assassination for you without you knowing it, and now she is sacrificing herself for you.
You won't let her sacrifice herself again this time.
Sumire must come back with me. She's my Sinner.

You extend your hand to use the shackles, trying your best to reach the woman behind the screen in the distance. But in a split second, you feel excruciating pain in your left arm. It goes numb, hanging on your body, unable to move.
Fortunately, you are now used to the pain from the toxin earlier today.
The Mentor's shadow has not moved the slightest the entire time, as if it's imprinted on the paper screen. You can't even sense how she attacked you and Sumire.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: I'll give you one last chance.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Leave.

An intimidating aura strikes you, darkening the surroundings. The murderous aura fills the small courtyard. It's simply impossible to imagine how powerful this woman, who calls herself the Mentor, really is.
It's as if every single cell in your body is screaming, urging you to run. But under this horrifying pressure, your mind becomes clearer than ever.
The dreadful murderous sense in the air is almost coagulating and dripping.
But you haven't taken a single step back.
You hold Sumire's hand firmly.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Is this your decision, Sumire?

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: You will be betrayed eventually.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I... don't care.
Before you realize it, the two people across the hallway are already gone. The candle flames in the tatami room are also out.
Now it's just you and Sumire in the courtyard, with all the flower petals drifting in the air.
For some reason, the Mentor seems to have decided to let both of you go.
Sumire is sitting on her knees. Your hands are still firmly held together.
You force yourself up onto your feet, try to carry Sumire and leave, but your body is too weak to do anything.
You tumble down and sit under the giant tree with white flowers in the center of the courtyard.
You've made far too many thoughtless decisions today. Perhaps the neurotoxin has affected your rationale.
You are extremely exhausted, and your surroundings begin to blur.
Sorry, I'm a little worn out.
Give me... a bit.
Sumire wipes off the blood at the corner of her mouth, smiles without saying anything, and lets you rest on her lap under the tree.
Petals sway and dance in the air, and Sumire opens an umbrella. Moonlight fills the courtyard, making everything look incredibly surreal.
It feels just like a dream...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Maybe it is a dream.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Just take a nap here. It'll all be over when you wake up. Don't worry. I'll protect you.

options: It's me who will protect you

choices.text: It's me who will protect you

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Alright. You will protect me.
You don't seem to believe it at all.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I never doubted you.
Okay... but why?
Forget it...
You look at Sumire's smiling face and figure not to bother with questions for now.
You remember what the Mentor said... that "prophecy" of betrayal.
I will never betray you.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: I know.
Sumire smiles. After a pause, she looks up at the sky.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: The moon is beautiful tonight.
